title: Cow with sparkly eyes
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- cow body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='68' rx='30' ry='20' fill='#f5f0e8'/>
  <!-- body spots -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='62' rx='8' ry='6' fill='#3a2a4a'/>
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='74' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#3a2a4a'/>
  <ellipse cx='66' cy='58' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#3a2a4a'/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x='28' y='82' width='7' height='12' rx='3' fill='#f5f0e8'/>
  <rect x='40' y='84' width='7' height='10' rx='3' fill='#f5f0e8'/>
  <rect x='55' y='84' width='7' height='10' rx='3' fill='#f5f0e8'/>
  <rect x='66' y='82' width='7' height='12' rx='3' fill='#f5f0e8'/>
  <!-- hooves -->
  <rect x='28' y='91' width='7' height='4' rx='2' fill='#c98a5a'/>
  <rect x='40' y='92' width='7' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#c98a5a'/>
  <rect x='55' y='92' width='7' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#c98a5a'/>
  <rect x='66' y='91' width='7' height='4' rx='2' fill='#c98a5a'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='36' rx='20' ry='17' fill='#f5f0e8'/>
  <!-- head spot -->
  <ellipse cx='58' cy='28' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#3a2a4a'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <ellipse cx='29' cy='30' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#f5f0e8' transform='rotate(-25 29 30)'/>
  <ellipse cx='71' cy='30' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#f5f0e8' transform='rotate(25 71 30)'/>
  <!-- horns -->
  <path d='M36 22 Q33 14 38 12' stroke='#ffd98a' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M64 22 Q67 14 62 12' stroke='#ffd98a' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='46' rx='12' ry='8' fill='#f7b6c2'/>
  <!-- nostrils -->
  <ellipse cx='46' cy='46' rx='2' ry='2.5' fill='#c96a80'/>
  <ellipse cx='54' cy='46' rx='2' ry='2.5' fill='#c96a80'/>
  <!-- sparkly eyes -->
  <ellipse cx='43' cy='34' rx='4.5' ry='5' fill='#6b4fd8'/>
  <ellipse cx='57' cy='34' rx='4.5' ry='5' fill='#6b4fd8'/>
  <circle cx='44.5' cy='32' r='1.8' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='58.5' cy='32' r='1.8' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='42' cy='36' r='1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='36' r='1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- sparkle stars -->
  <path d='M68 24 l1.2 2.6 2.8 .4 -2 2 .5 2.8 -2.5-1.3 -2.5 1.3 .5-2.8 -2-2 2.8-.4z' fill='#fff3b0'/>
  <path d='M32 22 l1 2.2 2.4 .3 -1.7 1.7 .4 2.4 -2.1-1.1 -2.1 1.1 .4-2.4 -1.7-1.7 2.4-.3z' fill='#fff3b0'/>
  <!-- blush -->
  <ellipse cx='36' cy='42' rx='3' ry='2' fill='#f7b6c2' opacity='0.8'/>
  <ellipse cx='64' cy='42' rx='3' ry='2' fill='#f7b6c2' opacity='0.8'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M80 64 Q88 60 86 68' stroke='#f5f0e8' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='86' cy='70' r='3' fill='#3a2a4a'/>
</svg>
